CustomField.formula: TEXT( FLOOR( Initial_Response_Date__c - CreatedDate ) ) + ' days ' + TEXT( FLOOR( MOD((Initial_Response_Date__c - CreatedDate) * 1440, 1440) / 60) ) + ' hours ' + TEXT( ROUND(MOD( MOD((Initial_Response_Date__c - CreatedDate) * 1440, 1440), 60), 2) ) + ' mins'
CustomField.label: Time to Initial Response-Clock Hours
